fields.description: Calendar Date: [Entity] The Calendar Date represents the normalized [ReportPeriod]. This provides a common date to query for which is necessary due to irregularity in report periods across companies. For example, if the report period is 2015-09-26, the calendar date will be 2015-09-30 for quarterly and trailing-twelve-month dimensions (ARQ,MRQ,ART,MRT), and 2015-12-31 for annual dimensions (ARY,MRY). We also employ offsets in order to maximise comparability of the period across companies. For example consider two companies: one with a quarter ending on 2018-07-24, and the other with a quarter ending on 2018-06-28.
